faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIMA Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Assistant position at IIMA is 20th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in business, finance, or accounting, or have completed CA/CMA. Strong data analysis skills are also essential for this role.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Assistant position announced by the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIMA) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Research Assistant position at IIMA must be submitted through the online mode only. No other mode of application will be accepted.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the IIMA Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Assistant recruitment at IIMA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant role at IIMA primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad is offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this IIMA recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Assistant position is Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Candidates applying should be willing to work in this city.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Gujarat. However, it is advisable to check the official notification for specific state eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please visit the provided links for detailed information and to submit your application.
